messages:
Alex Kim: kicking off a short playbook thread for the 3-way pilot cutover (Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant) + AuroraEdge gateway. need alignment on ops, press timing, and go/no-go gates.
Mira Patel: thanks alex — main asks: runbook owner, dryrun window, SI readiness, and initial telemetry + perf targets.
Sam Ortiz: i can own the runbook and the dryrun checklist.
Jordan Lee: i'll coordinate with the HW team (AuroraEdge) for the gateway firmware snapshot and packaging cut.
Priya Rao (SI): SI team available for dryrun week of 5/13. we need sample datasets and connection manifests by 5/6.
Alex Kim: key dates proposal: 5/6 connectors + test data ready, 5/10 internal dryrun, 5/13 partner dryrun, 5/20 soft launch for pilot customers, 5/27 press embargo lift. how does that look?
Mira Patel: timeline looks tight but doable. add a buffer for legal review (KMS + data residency). need legal signoff by 5/9.
Sam Ortiz: noted. i'll add legal checklist item in the runbook: KMS keys, access policies, redaction rules.
Jordan Lee: HW ask — AuroraEdge needs the gateway image by 5/3 to burn and QA. can we move the connector manifests earlier?
Alex Kim: +1 to moving manifests earlier. Priya, can your team provide manifests by 5/2?
Priya Rao (SI): yes, we can do 5/2 if we get the schema and a sample delta of 10k rows today. will post a link to sample files.
integrations-bot: calendar event created: "3-way pilot dryrun (internal)" 2025-05-10T16:00Z — attendees: Alex, Sam, Jordan, Priya.
Mira Patel: perf targets: 95th pct latency < 120ms for embeddings calls, vector insert throughput >= 2000 docs/min for Qdrant path, Snowflake ingestion SLO: < 10min for 1GB batch. Please confirm.
Sam Ortiz: agree with perf targets. will add stress tests to the dryrun checklist and include a small chaos step for network latency.
Jordan Lee: monitoring — we need dashboards: model-serving tokens/sec, gateway device health, connector lag, connector errors. Ops to expose these via Console.
Alex Kim: ops + eng: Sam to define dashboard panels, Jordan to ensure gateway metrics emit prometheus labels we expect.
Sam Ortiz: also adding a telemetry contract: each connector must send trace_id on request headers, and we log tenant_id + route.
Priya Rao (SI): SI will validate trace propagation and run a smoke test that verifies data roundtrip and vector similarity sanity.
Mira Patel: announcement cadence: internal demo 5/15, targeted pilot customers 5/20 (invite only), press embargo 5/27. Marketing will prepare 1-pager and a short demo clip.
Alex Kim: who owns the press go/no-go checklist? we need legal, security, and marketing signoff.
Mira Patel: marketing owns draft, legal owns compliance signoff, security does the final data-flow review. assign Sarah from legal and Omar from security.
Sam Ortiz: added manual rollback steps to runbook: (1) flip traffic to canary instance, (2) disable gateway routing to Qdrant, (3) revert connector config to previous snapshot. will include exact CLI commands.
Alex Kim: include a table of contact points in runbook with paging details. oncall rotation for the pilot week: Eng-Platform + SI oncall buddy.
Priya Rao (SI): SI asks about SSO and KMS integration for pilot. do we use our KMS or the customer's?
Mira Patel: for pilot customers we'll use customer-managed KMS if available; otherwise Redwood-managed with strict isolation and audit logs. note this in the runbook.
Jordan Lee: hardware note — gateway firmware 2.1.4 has a known issue with bulk reconnects; we'll schedule a patch cut on 5/5. will block soft launch until patch verified.
Alex Kim: good catch. add firmware patch verification to the 5/10 dryrun checklist.
integrations-bot: doc updated: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/3way-pilot-runbook — runbook v0.1 uploaded by Sam Ortiz.
Sam Ortiz: pushed runbook v0.1 — includes dryrun checklist, CLI rollback snippets, test data links, and acceptance criteria. requesting review from Mira and Jordan.
Mira Patel: reviewing now. quick note: acceptance criteria must include end-to-end P95 latency, insertion throughput, error budget threshold (<=1% 5xx), and data fidelity checks.
Priya Rao (SI): will run SI validation matrix during partner dryrun and post a results table to the doc.
Alex Kim: ok next steps: Sam finalize runbook v0.2 with legal checklist & chaos tests by 5/7, Jordan finalize firmware patch and telemetry labels by 5/5, Priya deliver manifests + sample files by 5/2, Mira coordinate marketing/legal signoffs by 5/9.
Jordan Lee: logging note — gateway must include device_id and firmware_version in all logs. will add to spec.
Sam Ortiz: updated runbook: added legal checklist and basic chaos experiments. linking results here after the internal dryrun.
Mira Patel: if internal dryrun passes, we'll run partner dryrun on 5/13 as planned. if not, we'll push the partner dryrun by 1 week.
Alex Kim: final ask — please add a short blameless retrospective template to the runbook so we capture learnings.
Priya Rao (SI): will add SI's postmortem template as well.
integrations-bot: reminder set: runbook review due 2025-05-07T23:59Z.
Sam Ortiz: thanks everyone — i'll call out blockers in the runbook and ping individually for approvals.
Mira Patel: thanks team. i'll sync marketing/legal for the 5/9 signoff.
Alex Kim: locking this thread — any off-cycle blockers, DM me. :rocket:
